proposals.title: Advisory Vote on Adoption of Antibiotics Policy (1 of 2)
proposals.proponent: The Benedictine Sisters of Boerne, Texas; Green Century Capital Management, Inc., on behalf of the Green Century Equity Fund
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an enterprise-wide policy to phase out medically-important antibiotics for disease prevention in beef and pork supply chains, with sourcing targets, timelines, metrics and third-party verification.
proposals.evidence: Our Board unanimously recommends that you vote "AGAINST" Proposal 5.

proposals.title: Advisory Vote on Adoption of Antibiotics Policy (2 of 2)
proposals.proponent: The Shareholder Commons, on behalf of H.E.S.T. Australia Ltd.
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy that McDonald's comply with WHO Guidelines on Use of Medically Important Antimicrobials in Food-Producing Animals throughout its supply chains.
proposals.evidence: Our Board unanimously recommends that you vote "AGAINST" Proposal 6.

proposals.title: Advisory Vote on Annual Report on "Communist China"
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report on the nature and extent to which corporate operations depend on and are vulnerable to Communist China.
proposals.evidence: Our Board unanimously recommends that you vote "AGAINST" Proposal 7.

proposals.title: Advisory Vote on Civil Rights & Returns to Merit Audit
proposals.proponent: National Center for Public Policy Research
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an audit analyzing impacts of the Company's Diversity, Equity & Inclusion policies on civil rights, non-discrimination and returns to merit, publicly disclosed.
proposals.evidence: Our Board unanimously recommends that you vote "AGAINST" Proposal 8.

proposals.title: Advisory Vote on Annual Report on Lobbying Activities
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report disclosing lobbying policies, direct and indirect lobbying and grassroots payments, and board oversight of such payments.
proposals.evidence: Our Board unanimously recommends that you vote "AGAINST" Proposal 9.

proposals.title: Advisory Vote on Annual Report on Global Political Influence
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual transparency report on global public policy and political influence, disclosing expenditures and activities outside the United States.
proposals.evidence: Our Board unanimously recommends that you vote "AGAINST" Proposal 10.

proposals.title: Advisory Vote on Poultry Welfare Disclosure
proposals.proponent: The Humane Society of the United States
proposals.topic_summary: Requests disclosure of the specific "15 key welfare indicators" used in the company's chicken animal welfare program and how each is used.
proposals.evidence: Our Board unanimously recommends that you vote "AGAINST" Proposal 11.
